verdict.rationale: Cal.com's agents documentation explicitly points to an "official Cal.com CLI" that agents able to run commands should use instead of calling the API directly. It says the CLI handles authentication, versioning, and common workflows automatically, so an official, agent-oriented CLI is a first-party claim. The evidence is limited to this one passage on a single page, so its depth and coverage are unproven. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI documentation (install instructions, command reference, supported operations), detail on how it covers bookings, event types and schedules, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
